description: External heartbeat configuration for the independent-failure-domain heartbeat required by Ops-04. The real config file lives outside Git (e.g. ~/.config/omnicraft/external-heartbeat.json) and is validated against this schema by verify-alerts.sh and alert-drill.sh.

provider.description: Independent monitoring provider (must differ from the app failure domain).

api_base.description: Provider API base URL used to query check status.

check_uuid.description: UUID of the configured heartbeat check.

ping_url.description: HTTPS URL pinged by the heartbeat cron to signal liveness.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the provider API key; the key itself never appears in files.

email_channel_id.description: Provider channel/contact that receives missing-heartbeat notifications.

grace_seconds.description: Allowed silence before the provider marks the check down.

timeout_seconds.description: Expected ping cadence; exceeding timeout+grace fires the notification.
